tests: an ActiveX DLL with Register DLLs to HKLM shows the HKLM warning twice as it opens
a Standard EXE with Register DLLs to HKLM shows the HKLM warning too, twice as it opens
steps:
1. In an IDE that is not elevated, open an ActiveX DLL project with Register DLLs to HKLM set to YES.
2. The box WARNING: This project registers itself to the HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE registry hive ... shows; choose Continue Anyway. The same box shows again; choose Continue Anyway again.
3. Open a Standard EXE project with the same setting set to YES: the same box shows, twice, though a Standard EXE registers nothing.
Control: an ActiveX DLL registered in HKCU opens with no box.
